title: Kitbash and insert library
summary: Your library of reusable pieces (screws, bolts, vents, panels) and how you place them on models.

request.brief: Submit the kit you actually use: your kitbash or insert library .blend (or a sample of the 10-30 pieces you use most). Also submit one model where you used those pieces, so the way you place, scale and instance them shows.
must_include: Your kit or insert pieces (asset-marked or not)
Only pieces you made yourself or have the right to share inside a skill
request.submit: Two .blend files: the kit and a model using it. Kits you bought may have licences that forbid redistribution; say so and they'll be catalogued but not copied into the skill.

questions.ask: Can your kit pieces be copied into the skill you build?
How do you place inserts? (snapping, an add-on such as KIT OPS, by hand, scripts)
